segments.oily: One reviewer with oily skin calls it a light, non-oily, hydrating everyday sunscreen with no white cast.
segments.dry: Reviewers with dry skin report it as very hydrating and nourishing, though one combination-skin user says it is not moisturizing enough alone and needs layering over moisturizer in cold weather.
segments.combination: Combination-skin reviewers describe it as lightweight, blending well even on their skin type, with one noting it still requires blotting powder on the T-zone.
segments.sensitive: Two reviewers describe their skin as sensitive and report no reactions or irritation, while one reviewer had an adverse reaction and another broke out in blackheads.
segments.mature: Mature-skin and mom reviewers report a brightening, glowing effect and a look of reduced fine lines, with one calling it a holy grail for aging skin.

concerns.aging: Several reviewers using it for anti-aging report reduced appearance of fine lines, a glow, and fading of dark/sun spots after regular use; effects are described as visual/short-term, not clinically verified.
concerns.dehydration: Most reviewers say the formula leaves skin hydrated, soft, and non-tight; one dry-skin reviewer found it insufficiently moisturizing on its own and layered it over a moisturizer.
concerns.redness: One reviewer with sometimes-sensitive skin reports no reactions and no visible irritation despite the high SPF.
concerns.barrier: No reviewer discusses barrier repair specifically; sensitive-skin comments focus on absence of stinging or reaction rather than barrier function.
concerns.spots: Two reviewers report the sunscreen helped fade or prevent dark spots and melasma with continued use.
concerns.blemishes: Reviewers are split: several say it caused no breakouts and is non-comedogenic even on acne-prone skin, but one reviewer developed new blackheads on cheeks, chin and forehead that stopped when she discontinued use.
concerns.oiliness: Oily-skin and general reviewers consistently describe the finish as non-greasy and non-oily, with no shine reported.

extraits.texte: so i was really excited when i saw that vichy gifted me this daily sunscreen because i had just received a vitamin c serum and you can't wear one without another. i loved that it didn't have that sunscreen smell that most spfs have and that it didn't leave a white cast. it also absorbs really nicely and gives a surprisingly amount of moisture for a spf. seriously, you can easily wear it with or without a moisturizer on top depending on the day. i tried it for a week and was content with it everytime i applied it on. the only problem is that it gave me blackheads. at first i wasn't sure if it was a coincidence or not, but i almost never get blackheads on my cheeks, chin, and forehead and this all happened in the week that i was using this product. i stopped using this product and the random blackheads stopped so im sure it was indeed the cause of it. thankfully i am an esthetician so i easily got them out without a problem. other than that issue i would've loved this product and rebought it

LOVE this product! I have very dry skin and struggle to find products that are nourishing to my skin. I love that this is a large size product at a comparable price point as my current sunscreen that is a much smaller container. This is very hydrating and I love that my skin is protected without a heavy cream or whitecast. Highly recommended!

This reminds me of La Roche Posay's AOX 50 serum, but I prefer this one because it does not contain oxybenzone, and the packaging is more handy for travel. The texture is fluid without being unduly runny, and it spreads easily without dragging. It has no fragrance, which I prefer. I have combination skin. This sunscreen is lightweight enough for my T-zone and neck, but I always have use blotting powder on my T-zone, no matter what. It is not moisturizing enough to keep from flaking around my drier cheeks and mouth, so I layer it over moisturizer for cooler weather (I have a heavier daily sunscreen for harsh Northeast winter weather). The texture feels more like serum than sunscreen, so it washes off easily at the end of the day. I'm glad I found this.

extraits.titre: Great everyday sunscreen for oily skin
extraits.texte: This is a light and non-oily sunscreen that I have been loving. The consistency is watery and smooth. This has no white cast and still feels hydrating. New daily go to suncreen.

Honestly, I am shook over the results. I've used Skinceuticals, Naturium, etc……this one gives moisture, darkens light spots quickly, just the right glow on combo skin during heat & humidity, beautifully layers under makeup, doesnt irritate eyes when used carefully. Been using for 2 weeks and the compliments keep coming! Not kidding, feel as though this has taken 5-10 years off my skin. Wore to beach vacay and NO sunburn!

extraits.titre: Solid product, will continue to use
extraits.texte: Thank you to Vichy, for gifting me the Capital Soleil UV Age Daily Sunscreen SPF 60 through BzzAgent's sampling program! I enjoyed the formula. It is nice and light, has a silky feel, and my sometimes sensitive skin had no reactions. I didn't notice a white cast, or the smell, that often accompanies sunscreens. (Even with an SPF of 60!!!) So far, so good. I will continue to use this one for sure.

extraits.titre: Love it but a little sticky
extraits.texte: I received this spf for free in exchange for an honest review. It plays well with the Vichy LiftActiv 16% vitamin c that I also reviewed. I am an avid SPF girl and use it religiously every day and re-apply throughout the day. This is a beautiful sunscreen. It blends in well, leaving no white cast. It has a slight smell but isn't overpowering. I took away a star because it leaves my skin feeling sticky. Maybe the formulation is better for drier complexions but I didn't like the way my skin looks/feels hours after application.
